Each operation involves splitting an integer x into two parts, \left \lfloor \dfrac{x}{2} \right\rfloor and \left\lceil \dfrac{x}{2} \right\rceil, and paying x yen for the operation. The process continues until all integers on the blackboard are less than 2. The total payment should be the sum of all integers that were chosen and split during the operations.

This results in incorrect splitting of the integer x, which affects the recursive calculation and the final sum. The specification needs to be corrected to use the floor and ceiling functions to accurately represent the intended operation of splitting the integer x.
